extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF text; no worker-5 direct-mechanism expansion was performed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fatty-acid chain length and position are associated with antimicrobial potency across the S3(B) cyclic lipopeptide analogues; C8-C12 substitutions at positions 5 and 7 are the best-performing source-supported structure-activity region.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a phenotype/structure-activity association, not a direct molecular mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hemolytic activity increases with hydrophobicity/fatty-acid length in the tested analogues, with Table 1 giving percent hemolysis at 150 uM.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper interprets hemolysis trends by hydrophobicity; it does not establish a direct membrane-disruption mechanism for each analogue.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: (C8)5 shows concentration-dependent killing of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in time-kill experiments, with 5x MIC producing a larger early reduction than 1x MIC.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=14:2.2.4. Time-Kill Experiment of (C8)5 Against P. aeruginosa

mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill kinetics support bactericidal/bacteriostatic phenotype, not a direct cellular target or pore mechanism.

unpromoted_claims: General introduction statements about AMP membrane permeabilization, LPS, or immune modulation are background context and are not promoted to direct mechanisms for the peptides in this paper.
